variants.title: 夕日の中で振り返る
variants.description: 本編のラストにいちばん近い、袖に触れて振り返る瞬間。
variants.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story.
Asset type: one new standalone 16:9 landscape ending-scene CG for a Japanese visual novel.
Primary request: an emotionally satisfying ending illustration featuring only Mizu (みず) and Ame (あめ), consistent with the character reference art and the user's approved title key-visual series.
Input images: Image 1 is Mizu's authoritative character identity and costume reference. Image 2 is Ame's authoritative character identity and costume reference. Image 3 is the user-approved title artwork and the authoritative reference for polished illustration style, facial rendering and color quality. Image 4 is the existing ending scene and a reference for the seaside promenade setting ONLY. This is a NEW illustration, not a retouch of any input. Follow the new framing specified below.
Story context: the last narrated scene takes place after an exhibition beside the sea at sunset. Mizu notices the approaching viewpoint character, touches Ame's sleeve, and then Ame also turns around. The three resume a conversation while listening to the waves. The viewpoint character is off-camera: depict ONLY the two women, with no visible third person or first-person hands. Convey lingering warmth, companionship and a story continuing beyond the final page.
Character invariants: two young adult university women with the exact designs in Images 1 and 2. Mizu has waist-length slate/ocean-blue hair loosely half-up at the sides, a small white wave/infinity hair clip, blue eyes with gold accents, a cream collared long-sleeved blouse, a mint ribbon, a dark-teal belted below-knee pinafore dress, white socks and black Mary Jane shoes. Ame has a chin-length pale icy-blue bob, a small white cloud hair clip, blue-lavender eyes with gold accents, an ivory collared knee-length dress with thin light-blue hem stripes and a pale-blue neck bow, a pale-blue cable-knit button cardigan, white socks and pale-blue loafers. Keep face shapes, hair lengths, clips and clothing construction clearly recognizable. Do not swap character traits.
Style/medium: the same finely drawn, beautifully painted anime style as Image 3, delicate clean linework, natural expressive faces, luminous atmospheric color, richly observed fabrics and hair, cohesive cinematic visual-novel ending CG; not chibi, not photorealistic or 3D.
Text: no title, no logo, no credits, no captions, no letters, no watermark, no UI. The game adds text separately.
Constraints: exactly Mizu and Ame, no extra people, crowds, background silhouettes, reflected duplicate people, mascots or animals. Natural coherent hands and limbs; fully clothed; no redesigned outfits. A single full-bleed wide illustration, not a collage. Warm, quietly fulfilled ending mood, no sorrowful farewell, graduation, fantasy transformation, catastrophe or invented dramatic event.
Scene/backdrop: the familiar seaside exhibition promenade, the sea and sinking sun beyond the iron railing, distant coastal hills and a small lighthouse. The exhibition is over; only a couple of quietly folded white canopies at the distant edge suggest the event, without people.
Composition/framing: medium-wide cinematic CG, women shown from just below the knees upward in the right half. Their bodies were walking away but both turn toward the camera in natural three-quarter views. Mizu gently touches the OUTSIDE of Ame's cardigan sleeve with one relaxed hand, not gripping; Ame turns half a beat later with an inviting smile. Each face is fully visible and their two signature hair clips are distinct. Long hair catches the sea breeze. Let the left and upper-middle open into softly glowing sea and sky.
Lighting/mood: peach-gold evening rim light, luminous blue-green sea shadows, warm cream fabric highlights. A quiet moment of being noticed and welcomed back. Use the approved title image's polished finish, but a distinctly new natural sleeve-touching gesture and viewpoint.
